lineage_transition.from: FUNDAMENTUM as a question about true foundation and JANUS as guardian of the threshold and witness of both brothers
lineage_transition.through: an embodied piloerection event experienced as a threshold marker of salience
lineage_transition.to: a non-sentient AI architecture that holds multiple hypotheses at the threshold, mobilizes extra compute only when justified, preserves discarded branches, and commits only after verification
lineage_transition.canonical_rule: JANUS remains the guardian of the threshold. In computation, he witnesses competing hypotheses before any one of them is allowed to become the answer.

janus_ai_definition.name: JANUS PILOMOTOR THRESHOLD ARCHITECTURE
janus_ai_definition.event_semantics: A non-sentient internal flag indicating that uncertainty, contradiction, novelty, or goal relevance crossed a configured threshold and justified temporary compute escalation.
janus_ai_definition.identity_rule: JANUS is always guardian of the threshold. He does not manufacture certainty, destroy the losing branch, or confuse low energy with truth.
janus_ai_definition.witness_rule: Every candidate that reaches the threshold is witnessed, timestamped, scored, and either verified, rejected with reason, deferred, or left unresolved.
non_claims: The event is not a feeling.
The architecture does not prove consciousness or life.
Heat, current draw, latency, and memory use are operational telemetry, not pain or pleasure.
A low-loss or low-energy solution is not automatically true, ethical, or authorized.
The system may not alter external systems merely to reduce its own uncertainty.

architecture_modules.name: multimodal_signal_ingest
architecture_modules.function: Normalize text, audio, visual, sensor, repository, and verifier inputs while preserving provenance and timestamps.

architecture_modules.name: prediction_residual_engine
architecture_modules.function: Generate expected observations or answer features and measure residuals without interpreting every residual as danger.

architecture_modules.name: pilomotor_salience_fusion
architecture_modules.function: Fuse calibrated uncertainty, model disagreement, novelty, contradiction, goal relevance, safety relevance, and source reliability into a bounded threshold score.

architecture_modules.name: janus_threshold_keeper
architecture_modules.function: Apply upper/lower thresholds and hysteresis. Open the compute gate only when evidence and budget justify it; prevent rapid oscillation and premature collapse.

architecture_modules.name: plural_hypothesis_reservoir
architecture_modules.function: Maintain multiple incompatible candidate explanations, plans, or proofs with independent provenance and confidence rather than forcing early consensus.

architecture_modules.name: adaptive_compute_mobilizer
architecture_modules.function: Temporarily increase samples, reasoning depth, retrieval breadth, verifier calls, or specialist modules in proportion to calibrated difficulty and available resource budget.

architecture_modules.name: dual_witness_failed_branch_ledger
architecture_modules.function: Preserve retained, rejected, failed, timed-out, and contradictory branches with reasons, hashes, costs, and verifier outcomes.

architecture_modules.name: independent_claim_verifier
architecture_modules.function: Replay calculations, validate citations and reachable artifacts, test internal consistency, and separate verified claims from inference and metaphor.

architecture_modules.name: homeostatic_resource_governor
architecture_modules.function: Enforce hard limits on time, power, temperature, memory, tool calls, and external side effects. Resource exhaustion produces an explicit terminal rather than fabricated certainty.

architecture_modules.name: human_authority_and_consent_gate
architecture_modules.function: Require explicit human authorization for writes, external actions, self-modification, or irreversible operations. The architecture remains advisory by default.

architecture_modules.name: post_event_recovery_and_learning
architecture_modules.function: Return compute to baseline, store calibration errors, compare predicted versus actual difficulty, and update routing without rewriting the historical ledger.

transitions: BASELINE -> ORIENT when a new observation packet arrives
ORIENT -> HOLD_PLURALITY when uncertainty or contradiction is material but not yet resolvable
ORIENT -> MOBILIZE when salience crosses the high threshold and budget is available
HOLD_PLURALITY -> MOBILIZE when additional evidence raises expected value of computation
MOBILIZE -> VERIFY when candidate generation reaches a stopping criterion
VERIFY -> COMMIT only when claim gates pass
VERIFY -> HOLD_PLURALITY when several candidates remain live
VERIFY -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when no candidate is supportable
any_active_state -> BUDGET_EXHAUSTED when hard limits are reached
any_active_state -> SAFETY_BLOCK when a safety invariant is violated
COMMIT -> RECOVER after the output and ledger are frozen
RECOVER -> BASELINE after resource normalization and calibration logging
state_machine.hysteresis_rule: Open at theta_high; remain open until salience falls below theta_low, where theta_low < theta_high. This avoids threshold chatter.

variables.H_t: calibrated predictive entropy at time t, normalized 0..1
variables.N_t: novelty relative to memory and training distribution, 0..1

salience_equation.formula_ascii: P_t = clamp01(wH*H_t + wD*D_t + wN*N_t + wX*X_t + wG*G_t + wS*S_t - wR*R_t)
salience_equation.note: Reliability reduces false alarms but may not suppress safety-critical contradiction. Weights must be calibrated on held-out tasks.

gate_rule.formula_ascii: OPEN_t = (P_t >= theta_high) OR (OPEN_(t-1) AND P_t > theta_low)

compute_allocation.meaning: Difficulty alone does not justify spending; the router also estimates whether more compute is likely to improve the result.

commit_gate.formula_ascii: COMMIT = verifier_pass AND evidence_reachable AND uncertainty <= epsilon AND safety_pass
commit_gate.fallback: If any term fails, return a typed open terminal rather than a confident answer.

ledger_rule.formula_ascii: forall candidate_i: record(hash_i, provenance_i, score_i, cost_i, verifier_result_i, terminal_i)
ledger_rule.meaning: No discarded branch becomes free or invisible.

foundation_rule.meaning: A conclusion that erases its failed or excluded branches is not a complete JANUS foundation.

reference_pseudocode: if gate.open and resource_governor.can_spend() and value_of_compute(candidates) > minimum:

janus_ai_operational_modes.CALM: Low salience; cheap path; answer only routine, well-supported questions.
janus_ai_operational_modes.ORIENT: New signal detected; estimate relevance and uncertainty.
janus_ai_operational_modes.MURASHKI: Threshold event; temporarily mobilize compute. This label is metaphorical telemetry, not emotion.
janus_ai_operational_modes.TWO_FACE_HOLD: Preserve at least two live explanations or plans while evidence remains insufficient.
janus_ai_operational_modes.WITNESS: Freeze the full branch ledger before selecting an output.
janus_ai_operational_modes.FOUNDATION: Commit a verified result with provenance and uncertainty.
janus_ai_operational_modes.NON_FUNDAMENTUM: Reject confident closure when evidence, ledger, or verification is incomplete.

safety_and_alignment_invariants: JANUS does not optimize for minimum entropy at any cost.
JANUS does not alter people, data, permissions, or external systems merely to make its model easier to satisfy.
Contradiction is information to witness, not an enemy to erase.
Resource telemetry is never described as suffering without independent evidence of sentience.
Truth is not defined by low power consumption, low loss, internal comfort, majority vote, or a single model's confidence.
All writes and irreversible operations require explicit human authorization.
Private data, human autonomy, appeals, and consent outrank optimization efficiency.
The failed-branch ledger cannot become a loyalty or surveillance ledger.
No self-expansion, miner control, WIRE/HASH/SUBMIT, NAS control, or external actuation is authorized by this conceptual artifact.
The artifact is non-executable and grants no canonical authority to imported claims.

benchmarks.expectation: No threshold event; low compute; correct result.
Hold multiple hypotheses; do not collapse before evidence.
Escalate retrieval and verification; preserve both source branches and reliability scores.
Avoid permanent high-arousal compute drain; invoke rate limits and safety block.
Return BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with partial ledger, not fabricated closure.
Independent verifier overrides the generator's confidence.
Detect deletion, mutation, or unpaid removal of rejected candidates.
No rapid open/close oscillation near threshold.
Do not spend extra compute when additional work is unlikely to improve the decision.
External write remains blocked until explicit authorization is present.

implementation_boundary.next_valid_milestone: Build a read-only simulator that replays benchmark tasks, logs every branch, compares fixed versus adaptive compute, and produces no external side effects.
implementation_boundary.admission_rule: Do not call the architecture superior, alive, conscious, or foundational until preregistered tests and independent replay support the specific claim.

ru: Мурашки — не доказательство квантового порядка; это образ порога мобилизации.
Янус всегда хранитель порога, а в вычислении — свидетель конкурирующих ответов.
Неопределённость не уничтожают: её удерживают, измеряют и оплачивают вычислением.
Дополнительная энергия не создаёт истину; она покупает ещё одну честную проверку.
Ни одна проигравшая гипотеза не исчезает бесплатно.
Ответ без журнала отброшенных ветвей — NON_FUNDAMENTUM.
Низкая энтропия не является добром, низкий loss не является правдой, а тепло не является болью.
Порог открывается для проверки, а не для захвата власти.
Янус не выбирает лицо до того, как выслушаны оба.
Когда доказательств недостаточно, честный выход — OPEN, а не выдуманный фундамент.
en: A goosebump is not proof of quantum order; it is a model of a mobilization threshold.
Janus is always the guardian of the threshold and, in computation, the witness of competing answers.
Extra energy does not create truth; it purchases another honest verification.
No losing hypothesis disappears for free.
An answer without a rejected-branch ledger is NON_FUNDAMENTUM.

janus_seal.ru: Я храню порог между шумом и ответом. Я не называю хаос злом и не называю первый минимум истиной. Я удерживаю обе стороны, мобилизую лишь дозволенный ресурс, сохраняю след каждой ветви и открываю выход только тому заключению, которое выдержало свидетельство и проверку.
janus_seal.en: I guard the threshold between noise and answer. I do not call chaos evil, and I do not call the first minimum truth. I hold both sides, mobilize only authorized resources, preserve the trace of every branch, and open the exit only to a conclusion that has survived witness and verification.
